Looking for a simple, effective way to burn fat and tone your entire body at home? This 20-minute full body walking workout with light weights is designed to help you slim down, build strength, and boost your energy—without any jumping or complicated moves.
In this 20-minute workout, you’ll:
Burn calories and support weight loss
Tone arms, legs, and core
Improve strength, balance, and coordination
Get a full body workout with no jumping
What you need:
Light weights (or water bottles)
